title: AI-Supported Decision Assistance in Postmortem Kidney Transplantation — A Concept Paper
description: Concept paper documenting a decision-science framework for AI-supported, assistive decision assistance at the center level in postmortem kidney transplantation, in the Eurotransplant context. Includes a three-phase study architecture (retrospective cohort, prospective shadow mode, interventional pilot), Decision Curve Analysis as primary methodological endpoint, and a translational pathway addressing MDR and EU AI Act compliance. Released as prior-art ahead of clinical implementation.
